notes: [withdraw-01 (OWNER 10-04 ~02:50Z: bots WITHDRAW from chests; never drop items; WITHDRAW_LOADED_MODE=hold -- junkswap only once a disposal exists; a survival release may close loaded as an emergency). Variant for fleet 6c9a8fb, branch wd-on-6c9a8fb @ 2691727 = ce0ec4a..2691727 (withdraw, six review rounds) ON TOP OF the chest-full fix (chest-on-1918bb5 @ 6c9a8fb, both engines approved). BASE: withdraw imports chest-full's town container memory (chestfull.mjs), so it cannot run before chest-full without a port. ONE-VARIABLE LINE: chestfull-01 is LIVE as exactly 6c9a8fb on fleet 1918bb5 (declared 10-05 02:46:55Z). If it is KEPT and promoted as 6c9a8fb, this registration applies as written (variant 2691727 = 6c9a8fb + withdraw only). If the fleet sha differs at launch, rebase wd-on-6c9a8fb onto it, rename this file withdraw-01.<that sha>.json and set `sha` -- read, gates and change rows are base-independent. Fix review P2-A/P2-B first (a new sha). NOT CHAINED.] MOTIVE (census 10-04 02:52Z): 897 usable stone pickaxes in the town banks while 45 of 80 bots carried none; the old verb took the first copy by slot. THE CHANGE: a deterministic withdraw_pick town order at town (<= 48 of home) for a bag with no usable pickaxe (> 10 uses): ONE best usable copy from up to three containers, else the exact ingredients of one stone pickaxe; room only by banking a whole stack deposit would bank; with a FULL chest a 3-click trade of that stack for the pickaxe; every transfer verified on the server's bag (craftsync recount); withdrawn items held from deposit 10 min; a cursor that cannot be emptied is held (never a loaded close) with intervention_needed rows; survival release closes at once; craftsync clicks window-bound with a pre-invoke validate (inflight.mjs). PAPER SANDBOX (10-05, sandbox 25599, 1.21.8, fresh bot per trial, server slots of bag + chest + ground; cand 2691727 vs ctrl 1918bb5): (a) pick 2/2 took the 111-use pickaxe, nothing else moved; (b) ingredients 2/2 exactly cobblestone 3, stick 2, oak_planks 4; (c) full bag + full chest 2/2: stone x64 traded for the pickaxe, totals conserved, ground empty; (d) spent copies (6 and 7 uses) never taken 2/2, ingredients instead; (e) the withdrawn sticks/planks stayed through a deposit 2/2 and admission counted only the coal as bankable (5, not 11) -- the control also kept 2 sticks through its deposit, so the scene alone does not discriminate; (f) a held cursor (feather pickup race into the emptied slot) held 70 s with intervention_needed, then settled by itself when a slot freed (ground empty); a survival release (damage 2) with a full bag dropped the pickaxe (the accepted emergency); a KICK right after the first click dropped the cursor stack (stone x64) 2/2 although its bag slot was free -- vanilla AbstractContainerMenu.removed drops the carried stack when the player has disconnected; after the reconnect the bot withdrew the pickaxe in a new order. FOUND: a hold begun after the connection had already ended never ends (probes the dead client every 2 s, intervention_needed at 61 s, carried_local=-). Control: no order ever; the old verb took the SPENT stone pickaxe (6 uses) and reported success, and failed 'inventory is full' on every full bag. CLAUDE REVIEW of 98b95c8..2691727 (10-05): no P1; no regression found for ordinary crafting (the send filter judges only packets inside a ticketed dispatch; validate refuses only on a window mismatch or after an invalidate, which only withdraw issues). P2-A: craftsync's click_refused / click_dropped / click_drop_repair rows are logged with event: not kind:, so logEvent files them as `_undefined` with an empty detail (the read counts `_undefined`, 0 on the baseline). P2-B: the dead-connection hold above (holdUnsettled registers once('end') after the end; needs an ended-client check at entry and per tick). P2-C (design, pre-existing class): a disconnect drops whatever the cursor holds; the trade could use the hotbar-swap click (mode 2) so the cursor is never loaded.
